proposal.summary: The report describes an SQL injection in DataEase v.1.18.9 that allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information by supplying a crafted string that bypasses a blacklist function.
proposal.cwe_quote: SQL injection vulnerability in DataEase v.1.18.9 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via a crafted string outside of the blacklist function.

I.quote: allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via a crafted string outside of the blacklist function.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request a full technical report or PoC showing the vulnerable endpoint(s), exact injection vector, and impact details; if confirmed, prepare an advisory with a patch or mitigation (remove unsafe query concatenation, use parameterized queries) and notify users to update from v1.18.9.
